record.paper_title: Some open problems on well-filtered spaces and sober spaces
record.original_question: Characterize those directed complete posets P such that Sigma P is sober and, for every directed complete poset Q whose Scott space Sigma Q is sober, the product dcpo P x Q is again Scott sober.

evidence.quote: Question 4.8. Characterize those Scott sober dcpos P for which the products P × Q is Scott sober for every Scott sober dcpo Q.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(P,\le)$ be a directed complete partial order (dcpo): a poset in which every directed subset has a supremum. A subset $U\subseteq P$ is Scott open if (i) $U$ is an upper set ($x\in U$ and $x\le y$ imply $y\in U$) and (ii) for every directed subset $D\subseteq P$ with $\sup D\in U$, one has $D\cap U\neq\emptyset$. The collection of Scott open sets forms the Scott topology, and the resulting topological space is denoted $\Sigma P$.

A $T_0$ topological space $X$ is sober if every nonempty irreducible closed subset (a closed set that cannot be written as the union of two proper closed subsets) is the closure of a unique singleton. A dcpo $P$ is called Scott sober if $\Sigma P$ is sober.

For dcpos $P$ and $Q$, the product dcpo $P\times Q$ is endowed with the coordinatewise order, and $\Sigma(P\times Q)$ denotes the Scott topology on this product dcpo. It is known that $\Sigma(P\times Q)$ need not coincide with $\Sigma P\times\Sigma Q$, and that the product of two Scott sober dcpos need not be Scott sober.

Problem: Give an intrinsic order-theoretic characterization of all Scott sober dcpos $P$ with the following property: for every Scott sober dcpo $Q$, the product dcpo $P\times Q$ is again Scott sober.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open question on Scott sobriety stability under products. Subsequent work (2024) confirmed via counterexample that products of two Scott sober dcpos need not be sober, and gave partial positive results for certain classes of sober complete lattices, but no full characterization of dcpos $P$ for which $P\times Q$ is sober for every sober $Q$ has been established.

status_evidence.title: Products of two sober dcpo's need not be sober
status_evidence.snippet: We construct two dcpo's whose Scott spaces are sober, but the Scott space of their order product is not sober... if M and N are special type of sober complete lattices, then the Scott space of their order product M×N is sober.
status_evidence.claim: Confirms negative resolution of product sobriety in general and provides only partial positive results, leaving the characterization problem open.

status_evidence.title: A discussion of well-filteredness and sobriety
status_evidence.snippet: Discussion of open problems regarding sobriety and well-filteredness of Scott spaces of dcpos.
status_evidence.claim: Surveys the open status of characterization questions in this area.
